1.. Emergency Meeting regarding closure of beaches  -  Action: approved (Pass) Moved by Mike Posey {\rtf1\ansi\ansicpg1252\deff0\deflang1033{\fonttbl{\f0\fnil\fcharset0 Arial;}}
{\colortbl ;\red0\green0\blue0;}
\viewkind4\uc1\pard\cf1\fs24 Assistant City Manager Travis Hopkins presented a PowerPoint communication entitled: July 4th Holiday Beach Closure Consideration with slides titled: Background, Huntington Beach Options\par
\par
Delgleize: On all with CalCOG today, entire Board of Supervisors in Riverside in quarantine- HB population seems to becoming more aware COVID is coming closer to HB. \par
\par
Semeta - question whether to give authority to City Manager to close beaches and/or what days.  Mr. Chi commented wanted to impact residents as little as possible.  Possibly just close the 4th - but be on watch to see if a Sunday closure is necessary.  Very concerned due to good weather and surf conditions if HB is the only beach open.  Track trend of other city closures.\par
\par
Posey - Seems a better time to close now than earlier beach closure.  Remains concerned for business also - how to close beach and not give business away to other cities.  Would like to see close on 4th, leave authority to close on 5th with Cty Mgr.  Downtown business service customers outside.  Institute beach closure on the 4th and option for 5th up to the City Manager, also closing parking lots but leaving bike path open.\par
\par
Carr - concerned about young kids or large groups congregating to beach.  In favor of closing beach on the 4th.  Possible to keep beach open for early hours only for surfing community on the 3rd, 4th and 5th, with parking and infrastructure closed.  Chief Handy responded - longer beach is open, more difficult it is to clear beach. Chief Haberle said staffing would be adequate. 9AM cut off.  Chief Handy highlighted the challenges his department already faces in lieu of today's atmosphere with clearing the beach.  Discussion ensued regarding Police staffing. \par
\par
Delgleize - Discussion with Chief Handy re: Sunset Beach affected the most in HB - most impacted.\par
\par
Semeta - emphasized how much council supports safety officers.\par
\par
Hardy - Feels beach should be closed, closure would only be for 3 days, not an indefinite closure as was done previously.  Does not support modified times to allow surfing in early morning.  Feels the Pier should be closed, keep bike path open. Closure should include all harbor and Sunset Beach beaches.\par
\par
Brenden - everyone sensitive to local business owners and taking business away.  Concerned having our beaches open even for a few hours.  Bike path needs to be kept open.  Suggestions: signage, importance of face covering, hand sanitizer on Main St.  Questioned re: county beach parking, all state lots closed.  Staff recommendation is to close all beach parking.  Concurs with CM Hardy a 3 day closure is best with regrets of effects on local businesses.  Close all except bike path.\par
\par
Chi - if other cities are open on Friday/ would like to stay open, general sentiments with other cities in OC is to close both Sat. & Sunday\par
\par
Brenden - concerned about Friday afternoon/night crowds, beginning of holiday weekend.\par
}
